_help: Fixes for the SUBTITLES. The subtitles are what the speech-to-text model hears, so a word you respelled in pronunciation-en.json (or one it mishears) can show up wrongly. Left = the wrong word shown in the subtitles (one word, or several words in a row such as "Comfy UI", any capitals). Right = the word you want shown. Keys starting with _ are ignored. Subtitles are rebuilt whenever a voiceover is redone; to rebuild only the subtitles, delete Subtitles\captions_NN.ass and run again.
